---
title: Band Compliant Fixture
description: A fixture whose blocks are already fixed points of the default reflow mode.
---

A compliant wrapped paragraph occupies most of the permitted band width in its first authored line
and finishes with this short tail.

- **A list item:** whose authored continuation already fills the band width and therefore stays
  exactly as authored here.

A closing paragraph references the note once.[^10]

[^10]: A footnote label whose continuation lines are indented to align under
       the label text itself so each chunk keeps its own line exactly.
